BiblicalUsage: Hanes = "grace has fled"; 1) a place in Egypt, site uncertain but may be either of the following; 1a) Tahpanhes, a fortified town on the eastern frontier; 1b) a place in lower Egypt, on an island in the Nile south of Memphis
